name: audience_from_salesforce
description: Build a matched audience from a Salesforce SOQL query that selects an email column. Closes the loop: flagged accounts/contacts -> DMP segment. Requires the local `sf` CLI to be authenticated.

soql.description: SOQL selecting an email column, e.g. SELECT Email FROM Contact WHERE ...

name: compute_lift
hostedNote: Needs the local change journal, ~/.adwarp/changelog.jsonl. Journaling is off on hosted deploys, which have a read-only filesystem.
description: For each recorded change to an entity, compare performance in the window before the change against the window after it (default 14 days each side). Returns before/after KPI windows and per-metric relative deltas (CTR, CPC, conversion rate, cost-per-conversion, etc.). This is a directional pre/post comparison, NOT a controlled experiment. It is confounded by seasonality, the LinkedIn learning phase after edits, and concurrent budget changes; present it as a signal and call out partial after-windows on recent changes.

windowDays.description: Days on each side of a change (default 14)

name: create_campaign
description: Create a campaign (the 'ad group') with targeting, budget, bid or bidding strategy (optimizationTargetType MAX_CLICK = Maximum Delivery on landing page clicks), schedule, and optional ad rotation (creativeSelection: OPTIMIZED or ROUND_ROBIN = rotate ads evenly). Defaults to DRAFT.

objectiveType.description: Campaign objective. Required to be ENGAGEMENT to sponsor another member's post (thought-leader ads).

optimizationTargetType.description: Bidding strategy. MAX_CLICK = Maximum Delivery optimized for landing page clicks (automated bid, charged CPM, unitCost ignored). Omit or NONE for a manual bid.

creativeSelection.description: Ad rotation: OPTIMIZED (LinkedIn default, favors the predicted winner) or ROUND_ROBIN (rotate ads evenly)

exclude.description: facet short name -> entity URNs to exclude

audienceSegmentUrn.description: urn:li:adSegment:... to target a matched audience

name: gads_launch_search_campaign
hostedNote: Not registered on the hosted endpoint. Run it on the local MCP server or the CLI.
description: Create a PAUSED Search campaign from a brief: budget, campaign, geo/language targeting, ad groups, keywords, and responsive search ads, all in one atomic mutate. Defaults to validateOnly=true, which asks Google to validate the whole batch and persist nothing. Show the returned plan to the user and only re-call with validateOnly=false after they confirm. House rules are applied automatically and cannot be overridden: search network only (display expansion and search partners off), physical-presence-only location targeting, and Manual CPC. Nothing created here can serve. Activation is a human step in the Google Ads UI.

customerId.description: 10-digit customer id; falls back to config default

dailyBudget.description: Amount in the ad account's currency, e.g. 150 for $150

cpcBid.description: Amount in the ad account's currency, e.g. 150 for $150

finalUrl.description: Landing page for ads that do not override it

locations.description: ISO country codes (US, GB) or raw geoTargetConstant ids

cpcBid.description: Amount in the ad account's currency, e.g. 150 for $150

matchType.description: EXACT and PHRASE keep B2B spend tight; BROAD needs strong negatives

path2.description: Second display-URL path segment. Requires path1: Google rejects path2 on its own.

conversionActionNames.description: Conversion actions to set as this campaign's goals; falls back to the config default

name: inspect_competitor_ads
hostedNote: Returns Ad Library metadata only, unless the server is configured with the remote creative worker.
description: Discover competitor ads through the official API. auto optionally queues up to 10 creatives on the remote worker; api returns metadata only. Always provide advertiser plus companyId to filter unrelated name matches before collection. No local browser or scraper fallback. Read pending results with get_competitor_creatives. Cached screenshots require worker authentication. Report sample coverage and collection dates; never retry a blocked worker or use another browser/client. Synthesize findings rather than dumping rows.

companyId.description: Numeric LinkedIn company id, more precise than name

keyword.description: Free-text keyword search across ad copy

countries.description: ISO-3166 country codes to scope, e.g. ['US','GB']

engine.description: auto = official API plus remote creative worker; api = metadata only. Local scraping is disabled.

deep.description: Enqueue up to 10 verified company ads on the remote worker; reuse cached creatives.

concurrency.description: Remote worker concurrency is fixed at one.

copyMax.description: Creative sample size, capped at 10. Worker budgets cannot be overridden.

name: log_ad_change
hostedNote: Needs the local change journal, ~/.adwarp/changelog.jsonl. Journaling is off on hosted deploys, which have a read-only filesystem.
description: Record a change to an ad entity in the local change journal, so a later lift report can compare performance before vs. after it. Adwarp logs its own changes automatically. Use this for changes made elsewhere (e.g. in Campaign Manager) or to attach a hypothesis/label. Provide field+after for a field change, or note for a freeform annotation.

entityId.description: Numeric id of the campaign group / campaign / creative

name.description: Human name of the entity (for nicer listings)

note.description: Freeform note (used when there is no specific field)

name: performance_trend
description: Weekly or monthly trend for one entity, with period-over-period deltas on impressions, clicks, spend, conversions, and CTR. Use to spot momentum or creative fatigue.

entityId.description: Numeric id of the account/group/campaign/creative to trend

name: search_targeting
description: Typeahead-search entities within a facet to get their URNs (e.g. facet='titles', query='marketing' -> Marketing Manager urn). Use 'list_facet_entities' for small fixed sets like seniorities. These URNs go into a targeting spec.

facet.description: short facet name, e.g. titles, industries, skills, staffCountRanges, locations

name: update_ad
description: Change a single ad's (creative's) status in place: PAUSED stops it serving, ACTIVE starts it serving, ARCHIVED retires it. Use PAUSED to stop an ad without touching the rest of its ad group. Accepts a numeric creative id or a full urn:li:sponsoredCreative URN. Setting ACTIVE starts spend, so set it only when the user explicitly asks to turn the ad on, never as a side effect of another request. An ACTIVE ad still only serves while its campaign (ad group) is ACTIVE. LinkedIn refuses to pause an ad that is still in review. Pass dryRun=true to preview the patch without sending it.

accountId.description: Numeric ad account id; defaults to the configured account

creativeId.description: Numeric creative (ad) id or a full urn:li:sponsoredCreative URN

status.description: PAUSED stops the ad serving. ACTIVE starts it serving and spending: set it only when the user explicitly asks. ARCHIVED retires it.

dryRun.description: Return the patch without sending it

name: update_campaign
description: Update an existing campaign (the 'ad group') in place: change its targeting and/or name, status, budget, bid, bidding strategy (optimizationTargetType, costType), schedule, ad rotation (creativeSelection: OPTIMIZED or ROUND_ROBIN = rotate ads evenly). Only the fields you pass change. Targeting is REPLACED when you pass any targeting form: a structured `targeting` spec, the `audienceSegmentUrn` (+ optional `geoUrns`) shorthand, or a raw `targetingCriteria`. Default exclusions are re-applied unless applyDefaultExclusions=false. Audience Expansion / Audience Network stay off. Pass dryRun=true first to preview the patch before touching a live campaign.

campaignId.description: Numeric campaign (ad group) id to update

include.description: facet short name -> entity URNs (ANDed across facets)

exclude.description: facet short name -> entity URNs to exclude

audienceSegmentUrn.description: urn:li:adSegment:... (or bare id) matched audience to target, which replaces existing targeting

geoUrns.description: urn:li:geo:... locations to include alongside the audience

costType.description: Change the cost type (CPM for Maximum Delivery)

optimizationTargetType.description: Bidding strategy. MAX_CLICK = Maximum Delivery optimized for landing page clicks (automated bid, charged CPM, unitCost ignored). Omit or NONE for a manual bid.

creativeSelection.description: Ad rotation: OPTIMIZED (favors the predicted winner) or ROUND_ROBIN (rotate ads evenly)

name: upload_audience_csv
hostedNote: Reads a CSV path on the server, not on your machine.
description: Clean a CSV at csvPath and upload it as a matched-audience DMP segment. Auto-detects contact (email) vs company (account) lists, normalizes column names, drops non-matcher columns, hashes emails, and converts company domains to website URLs. Requires the Audiences product; matching takes up to 48h.

csvPath.description: Path to the CSV file on the server

type.description: Force the list type; auto-detected if omitted
